clarksville.text: Dr. Morgan and his staff are so professional and courteous! They always listen to my needs and have helped many of my friends and colleagues! Keep up the great work!!

clarksville.name: Paige Allison
clarksville.text: There's a Chiropractor on every corner in Austin and yet I drive 15 miles to see this one. Excellent care and service by the whole team! Love them!

clarksville.name: Rick Opp
clarksville.text:
As always, Fast Excellent Service. Dr. Morgan is one of the best.
Their new facility is great and free garage parking is nice.

clarksville.name: Melba Tellez
clarksville.text: Dr. Morgan is hands down the best chiropractor I've ever had! I started going to his practice last year due to recurring back and neck pains, and after just a few visits, I saw a vast improvement! Now, nearly a year after my first visit, I am happy to say that my pain is completely gone. A big shout out also goes to Holly and Jenny who are super friendly and welcoming members of the staff. Highly recommend this place!

clarksville.name: Ricardo Montelongo
clarksville.text: I have been going to Dr. Morgan for over 5 years now and even got my wife to start going and we are absolutely pleased with the service we get. They truely care about your health at West End Chiropractic. All the staff are welcoming and friendly. Definitely recommend!

clarksville.name: Maricella Luna
clarksville.text: I've been so happy with the professionalism and great care by Dr. Morgan and his staff. I went in for a consultation and returned for a very thorough treatment plan a few days later. I've begun my adjustments and within days, I felt so much better after having been unable to relieve hip pain on my own for several months. I'm thoroughly impressed with his individualized treatment plan for me too. Thanks Dr. Morgan for giving me hope to be able to return to my physical activity soon!

west-austin.name: Gary Serwatka
west-austin.text: Went above and beyond my expectations. The staff was friendly and professional and Casey was very thorough. I look forward to exclusively using him as my chiropractor from now on.

west-austin.name: Joanette A
west-austin.text: Great customer service! It's my first time seeing a chiropractor and Dr. Morgan was very patient and knowledgeable and explained my issues thoroughly. Other doctors have prescribed pain killersand steroids for my problems to no avail. I appreciate Dr. Morgan's recommendations and I was able to have a speedy recovery in no time. Would definitely recommend!

west-austin.name: Barbara Brehm
west-austin.text: Everyone from the front desk staff to the doctors are friendly and professional. I have been seeing chiropractors for more than 30 years and Dr. Morgan really wanted to know what had worked for me in the past so his treatment would be effective and not overpowering. After only three visits I feel so much better and stronger. Highest recommendations to West End chiropractic! And super easy parking!

west-austin.name: Mallory Alton
west-austin.text: I've been coming to Dr. Morgan for a couple years now and it has truly been life changing. I used to experience debilitating pain in my neck after small amounts of exercise, but now I'm back to a full range of motion with no pain at all. Dr. Morgan knows what he's doing, and is staffed with the kindest people in Austin. Thank you!!

west-austin.name: Meg Terrazas
west-austin.text: I am so happy I visited West End Chiropractic today! I don’t know why I’ve waited so long between visits. I got right in without a long wait. Everyone is so pleasant and professional. And the best part is that I got immediate relief after Dr. Casey Morgan adjusted me! Thank you guys for being the best!!

west-austin.name: Tracie Moreno-Tubbs
west-austin.text: Thank you for review beginning to present. He is doing great job and he tried his best communication with me and ASL interpreter. I gave him 5 star 🌟 for his patient, nice and communication to explain before start. He work on my neck to bottom(hip) injury to massage and fix my body straight. Thank you Tracie M.

rosedale.name: Danielle Forward
rosedale.text: After seeing two other chiropractors for the same issue, I’m finally seeing some real results from Dr. Morgan, and very quickly! Dr. Morgan is a rare combo of warm demeanor, insanely high competence and extensive experience. I can tell he loves his job. Who wouldn’t want to hire that person? Friendly staff all around, streamlined process, reasonable prices. Thank you all for helping me keep amazing quality of movement to continue my fitness and strength training journey! 💛

rosedale.name: Brad Gerald
rosedale.text: I always have a great experience @ West End. The staff is super friendly. It's never a long wait. Casey is knowledgable & efficient.

rosedale.name: Patti Candelari
rosedale.text: Recommended! Tai, Gabby, and Dr Morgan are all terrific! If you have never had an Thompson Technique adjustment, Dr Morgan is the one to see! He's a 2nd generation chiropractor, the office is efficiently run by Tai and Gabby, and it's on the ground floor of 5th St Commons. Walking home after an adjustment rather than getting back behind the wheel - priceless!

rosedale.name: Jean Boda
rosedale.text: Best chiropractic visit I’ve ever had. The staff was so competent, helpful, and FRIENDLY. Dr. Morgan is personable, knowledgeable, and very clear. It feels like they care.

rosedale.name: Bryan Kupke
rosedale.text: Dr. Morgan and his staff are the friendliest bunch of people you will ever meet. And if that doesn't put less stress on your back, their services will. His treatment plans are realistic and achievable... in just a few weeks, I've felt better than I have in years! I recommend them to anyone (literally, all the time) who suffers from back pain.

rosedale.name: Lonely Promise
rosedale.text: Dr. Casey Morgan is a man that has a gift everyone. Not everyone can listens to you and understand your pain but, Dr. Morgan can. Not only does he listen he also Cares for his clients and remembers you. I'm so blessed to be cared for by a Doctor that truly wants to make a difference in his client's lives. Thank you Casey. You truly are a blessing. The Rivers family.
